papers.title: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models
papers.desc: Studies how to cut the per-iteration KV cache of depth-recurrent language models, comparing looped hybrids with mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet mixers, a Parcae-style workspace, and recurrent KV replay; replaying KV from every third of six loops scores 18.71 CORE against 18.96 with separate caches.

papers.title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LoopFill, a training-free decoder for looped LLMs that merges suffix-lookup drafts and shallow-loop predictions into one draft tree processed by the shared block in one batch, reaching 5.85x greedy speedup on Ouro-2.6B and 5.13x on Huginn-3.5B, 40% and 25% above LoopAhead.

papers.title: When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?
papers.desc: Tests eleven ways to loop a middle block of vision-language embedding models and proves image-first causal loops keep image states query-independent; on MMEB-V2 an added loop on Qwen3.5-2B loses 0.46 points to its single-pass control, while natively looped LoopVL-1B gains 4.23.

papers.title: LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
papers.desc: Introduces LoopSkim, which lets every intermediate loop readout of a looped LM check prompt-lookup draft tokens and fixes sampling noise per position to stay lossless; without training it averages 7.66x over autoregressive decoding under greedy decoding and 1.73x the speedup of LoopSpec.

papers.title: Latent Fact Composition under Next-Token Training
papers.desc: Introduces Baton looped transformers that pass a decoded bridge-entity embedding into the second loop; two of three variants answer about 99% of two-hop questions with unseen bridges under answer-only training, but next-token training makes that accuracy rise and then decline.

papers.title: InfuseLoop: Cross-Trajectory Latent Injection for Scalable Parallel Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Feeds already-computed hidden states from later token trajectories into each loop of a parallel looped Transformer through lightweight attention residuals; at eight loops this removes training-loss spikes and cuts perplexity 3.4-17.1% over vanilla parallel loops for 0.3% extra decoding time.

papers.title: LoopZip: Visual Token Compression for Efficient Looped Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Compresses visual tokens in looped vision-language models without training by selecting tokens from attention over the first two calls of a shared layer and fitting one shared value correction to both calls; LoopVL-1B keeps 97.16% of its accuracy and runs 2.01-2.47x faster.

papers.title: Proximal Targets: Training Looped Refiners on Problems with Many Correct Answers
papers.desc: Trains each pass of a TRM-style looped refiner toward the correct answer nearest its own input draft instead of one stored answer, making every answer a fixed point; a 1.7M-parameter model solves 98.8% of multi-answer Sudoku puzzles versus 2.5% with the standard target.

papers.title: LoopPrune: Recurrent Pruning for Looped Diffusion Transformers
papers.desc: Prunes looped diffusion Transformers with one mask shared by every loop position, scored by shared-removal effects and position variation, then recovers each loop position against a dense teacher; at 30% structured pruning Looped-DiT B/16 keeps 93.14% of dense accuracy.

papers.title: Where Global Context and Weight Sharing Work in Compact Vision Backbones
papers.desc: Ties repeated MBConv blocks of a trained EfficientNet-B0 to shared kernels with per-pass BatchNorm; alternating two templates in Stage 6 ([B1, A, B, A]) cuts parameters by 10.9% and reaches 70.92% ImageNet accuracy after one epoch, 1.84 points below the unshared control, while single-template tying trails by 6.66.

papers.title: Simpler Tiny Recursive Models
papers.desc: Replaces TRM's two states and nested loops with one state updated by a bank of per-channel exponential moving averages and read out from slow channels only; at equal parameters and compute it reaches 92.1% on Sudoku-Extreme versus 88.3% for TRM and does not collapse late in training.

papers.title: LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
papers.desc: Introduces LoopCache, a lossless self-speculative decoder for looped Transformers that updates drafts from every intermediate loop and cycles through loop-specific KV caches so each step reads one loop's cache, averaging 10.25x and 14.56x speedups over WaveFront Decoding and LoopSpec on 4K-128K contexts.

papers.title: Edge-RecViT: Efficient Vision Transformer via Semantic-Refined Dynamic Recursion
papers.desc: Introduces Edge-RecViT, combining a fully shared recursive ViT hidden layer with an edge-aware token ranker that allocates per-token depth and early exits for parameter- and FLOP-efficient vision.

papers.title: Implicitly-Defined Neural Networks for Sequence Labeling
papers.desc: Defines sequence hidden states jointly through a learned implicit system and solves the coupled nonlinear equations to enable non-causal bidirectional interactions for sequence labeling.

papers.title: ChainGPT: Dual-Reasoning Model with Recurrent Depth and Multi-Rank State Updates
papers.desc: Introduces ChainGPT, a dual-reasoning recurrent-depth architecture that combines multi-substep state updates and state-guided sparse attention to move reasoning into latent computation, with adaptive stopping as a supporting mechanism.

papers.title: MoDr: Mixture-of-Depth-Recurrent Transformers for Test-Time Reasoning
papers.desc: Introduces MoDr, which adds multi-branch routing to a depth-recurrent Transformer so looped models can explore solution paths more adaptively at test time.

papers.title: Polymorphic Universal Transformer
papers.desc: Introduces the Polymorphic Universal Transformer, adding conditional sparse subspaces and uncertainty-aware depth scheduling to shared-parameter recurrence to reduce compute while mitigating representational collapse.

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
papers.desc: Argues that once a looped language model's recurrent states approach fixed points, the endpoint can replace the trajectory, enabling truncated backpropagation, terminal KV sharing, distilled prefill up to 1.79x faster, and RL updates from saved rollout states about 2x faster; it shapes those fixed points with a depth prior learned from prediction feedback plus an entropy term and with orthogonal input injection, and at 1.6B parameters the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.

papers.title: Universal Speech Transformer
papers.desc: Adapts the Universal Transformer to speech recognition with shared iterative encoder and decoder computation, dynamic depth, one-time positional encoding, and full hidden-state updates.
